_comment: Pinned episode sequence for the 0:40-1:35 unbroken-take video beat. Generated by inspecting data/train.jsonl directly (not hand-picked): episode_ids are already ascending, which is also the order scripts/demo.py's load_episodes() re-sorts to internally, so this file's order and the run's actual playback order agree. Regenerate with the same derivation if data/generator.py's seed ever changes -- scripts/rehearse.py's preflight re-derives and asserts these properties from the live config/data on every run rather than trusting this file blindly.
_opener_note: epi_00006 opens AND is the drill-down/approval episode -- there is no separate pure auto-tier opener before it. Checked, not assumed: only epi_00001 and epi_00006 are gate-eligible among episode_ids < epi_00008 (everything else in that range fails an earlier gate check), and a real PolicyEngine.resolve() pass (not just the gate's amount-vs-ceiling tier) showed epi_00001 ALSO resolves human_keystroke -- via default_rule, not an amount effect -- because only 4 of the 108 gate-eligible train episodes match one of the 27 explicit policy rules at auto tier at all, and none of those 4 has an episode_id below epi_00008 (so none can play before the cluster halts the run). A two-approval opening would misrepresent 'gets a human keystroke above a rupee threshold' as this episode's reason for the gate firing when it demonstrably is not (its amount is under the ceiling). One episode, above the ceiling, is the honest version of this beat.
_episode_ids_note: position 1 (epi_00006) is the drill-down AND the approval beat in one -- gate-eligible, amount above the ceiling, resolves human_keystroke via the real choose engine (not just the gate's own amount check -- see approval_index assertion in scripts/rehearse.py). positions 2-41 are the full 40-episode issuer-outage cluster seeded in data/generator.py -- Runner.run() halts (stopping rule REASON_CLUSTER_ESCALATION) the instant the last one is processed, so nothing after epi_00047 is ever reached and does not need to be listed.
approval_amount_note: Rs 7,500 -- the real figure to say on camera. The blueprint's beat table narrates an illustrative 'Rs 12,400'; that number does not correspond to a real pinned episode and must not be spoken during the take.
